title: Whaly
tagline: SocialFi platform where token holders steer discussions. Token-centric forum empowering major holders, guiding crypto conversations.
description:
Welcome to Whaly, the Web3 SocialFi platform that reimagines how we discuss cryptocurrencies. At Whaly, we've created a space where token holders take center stage in shaping discussions about them. Our platform expands the possibilities for influential holders, ensuring their understanding and opinions take a prominent place in real-time discussions.

Imagine this: a forum where the largest token holders engage in discussions, setting the direction and providing invaluable insights. However, it's not just about the "whales"; it's about empowering every member of the crypto community. Small traders, enthusiasts, and retail participants benefit from the wisdom shared by these influential figures, gaining access to expert opinions that shape their strategies and decisions.

As an added incentive, every time a user creates a new token thread, they receive a unique NFT - the 'Token Thread Creator NFT'. This NFT signifies their contribution as a thread initiator, providing a distinctive digital asset linked to the discussion they've initiated.

Whaly is not just another discussion platform; it's changing the rules in the SocialFi sphere. Join us to be part of this transformative movement where discussions about tokens are led by those who ACTUALLY OWN them.
how_its_made:
We used NextJS and React for the frontend as well as lottie animations.
To connect wallets we used RaibowKit library which supports Metamask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet and Rainbow.

To interact with the blockchain we used ethers.js, wagmi and hardhat.

We support 7 EVM-compatible networks:
1.Base
2. Linea
3. Mantle
4. XDC
5. Arbitrum
6. Celo
7. Scroll Sepolia
